name: Mirror Lake
source:
Have you ever been seduced by a fish person? Yes? Well now you can swap roles in Mirror Lake!

Play as Fishleen, a fish person trying to woo Humanbert, a human person. Whether this fish-human interaction ends in a soulmate, rejection, or dinner (at least for one of the parties) will be up to Fishleen's human seduction skills!

[Edited from [url=https://vicdoan2.itch.io/mirrorlake]itch.io[/url]]
